sentences.japanese: 勤勉さが経験不足を補うこともあり得る。
sentences.english: Diligence may compensate for lack of experience.

sentences.japanese: それはまるで、経験不足は才能で補えると言っているようなものだ。
sentences.english: It sounds as if genius compensates for lack of experience.

sentences.japanese: あなたは来週その損失を補わなければならない。
sentences.english: You must make up the loss next week.

sentences.japanese: あなたの食事にはビタミンを補うほうがよい。
sentences.english: You had better supplement your diet with vitamins.

sentences.japanese: 彼女の非凡な才能が経験不足を補う。
sentences.english: Her genius makes up for her lack of experience.
